subject: Lane A acquired GPU for FLA causal-conv micro parity
body: Matched optimizer comparison accepted: BNB8 remains preferred for development recipe; TorchAO promotion rejected. Lane A is taking a short non-weight-changing GPU turn to run committed probe_v10r2_fla_causal_conv_parity.py at Lane-B head 6b44b87706fc3fff9521bbc41589c57d0478602f. Purpose is forward/backward/update/cache parity between Qwen3.5 PyTorch causal-conv semantics and installed FLA Triton causal-conv. No training data consumed, no optimizer, no model weight mutation. Release immediately after result.
